The '''Mission to Geonosis''' was a mission suggested by [[Rahm Kota/Legends|Rahm Kota]] to rescue a [[Squad/Legends|squad]] of rebels.

==Prelude==
In the wake of the [[Mission to Desolation Station|destruction]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Empire's]] manufacturing facility on [[Desolation Station/Legends|Desolation Station]], [[X2]] learned from Kota of a [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] unit that had been [[Infiltration of Geonosis Imperial base|captured]] on the planet [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]]. Kota told X2 to meet him on the planet, where the two would perform a surgical strike to rescue the captured Rebels.<ref name="Elite" />

==The Mission==
[[File:Boba_Fett_attacks_X2.jpg|thumb|left|200px|Boba Fett attacks X2, in order to set a trap for Rahm Kota.]]
Arriving to the planet after Master Kota, X2 encountered [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett's]] ship ''[[Slave I/Legends|Slave I]]'' in the midst of Geonosis's asteroid belt. Fett initially mistook X2 for Kota - whom he was pursuing due to an Imperial [[Bounty/Legends|bounty]] - but the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] determined to make the most of his discovery by capturing the [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] for use as a lure for the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]]. Fett underestimated X2's piloting skills, however, and was quickly sent fleeing by his adversary.<ref name="Elite" />

Down on the planet's surface, X2 appropriated a [[Speeder bike/Legends|speeder bike]] from the Imperials and raced to Kota's location in the Imperial facility. After joining up with his new [[master]] in the building's antechamber, the two proceeded together into the bowels of the facility, where they were forced to fight off intermittent harassment from [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] as they navigated the building's treacherous catwalks. In spite of the opposition, the pair were able to free many of the trapped soldiers, who were reluctant to retreat from the building instead of joining to fight. Once all of the Rebels had been liberated, Kota and X2 joined them outside the facility, where the group's escape route was obstructed by a heavily fortified Imperial emplacement. On Master Kota's advice, X2 managed to destroy the Imperials' [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generators]] with heavy weaponry, allowing the party to safely reach their escape craft and depart the planet.<ref name="Elite" />

==Aftermath==
Following the mission, the freed Rebels declared their loyalty to X2, who reluctantly accepted command of this new squadron. At Kota's suggestion, X2 named the [[Grey Squadron|new unit]] after his genetic father, [[Falon Grey]].<ref name="Elite" />
